title: Brain criticality predicts individual levels of inter-areal synchronization (Fusca, Siebenhuehner, Wang et al., 2023): SEEG/MEG PLV and DFA (derivative)
description: Derivative dataset repackaging the authors' public Dryad release of phase synchronization (phase-locking value, PLV; weighted phase lag index, wPLI) and detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA) results. The results come from resting-state SEEG of 68 drug-resistant focal epilepsy patients and MEG of 52 healthy participants, plus simulated hierarchical Kuramoto model data. The data support the finding that brain criticality, indexed by long-range temporal correlations, predicts individual levels of inter-areal synchronization. Raw recordings are not included.
methods_description: SEEG: 10 min of eyes-closed resting state per patient, recorded monopolar with 8-15 contacts per shaft. Windows with epileptic artifacts were rejected, grey-matter contacts were referenced to the closest white-matter contact, and data were filtered with an FIR broadband filter and 50 Hz notch filters. 24 Morlet wavelets (2-225 Hz) were used to compute PLV between contact pairs and DFA exponents per contact. MEG: 192 eyes-open resting-state sessions, source-reconstructed to the 400-parcel Schaefer atlas, with wPLI and DFA computed. Simulations used hierarchical Kuramoto models.
